subject: Vendor onboarding: multi-entity invoice routing and PO assignment for Aurora Systems
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@aurora-sys.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: multiple legal entities - invoice entity and PO mapping needed

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this morning. As discussed, Aurora Systems operates across three EU legal entities (Aurora EU S.A., Aurora Iberia SL, Aurora Nordics OY). We need to confirm how Redwood will map purchase orders and invoice routing to the correct legal entity so we can submit VAT-compliant invoices.

Quick summary of our ask:
- When Redwood issues a single PO, should we invoice the legal entity that matches the PO billing address, or will Redwood accept a split invoicing flow (one PO, multiple invoices to different legal entities)?
- Do you require a signed fiscal representative appointment for invoices issued from Aurora Iberia SL when using a non-resident VAT registration?
- Which invoice fields must be present in e-invoice XML for auto-PO-matching (preferably element names and examples)?

Attached: aurora_tax_residency_certificate.pdf (tax residency cert for Aurora Iberia SL).

We can provide a short sample XML if that helps. Please loop in procurement and tax so we can finalize the PO->invoice mapping and avoid delays at payment.

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Onboarding & Finance Ops
Aurora Systems

--
Aurora Systems (attachment: aurora_tax_residency_certificate.pdf)

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@aurora-sys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: multiple legal entities - invoice entity and PO mapping needed

Maria —

Thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the residency cert. Looping in Ben (tax) and Laura (procurement) and Karthik (intl tax) to confirm our approach. 

High-level proposal from procurement:
- Preferred: PO-level invoice entity mapping. Each PO should include a "billing_entity_id" field that maps to the legal entity Redwood will pay. This avoids split invoices against one PO.
- Acceptable alternative: If Aurora must invoice multiple legal entities for a single PO, invoices should reference the same PO number and include an additional field "invoice_legal_entity_vat_id" so our AP system can split payments downstream. Note this triggers additional reconciliation steps and may delay payment.

Could Ben/Karthik confirm tax implications for Spain (fiscal rep) and whether the attached residency cert is sufficient evidence to treat Aurora Iberia SL as non-resident for withholding / reverse-charge purposes?

Connor
Senior Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding: multiple legal entities - invoice entity and PO mapping needed

Team —

Thanks for flagging. Below is the recommended decision flow (concise) and the required invoice/e-invoice fields for automatic matching. I also attached an example CSV (entity-mapping-table.csv) with the three Aurora legal entities and suggested "billing_entity_id" values.

1) Entity selection logic (decision tree):
- If the PO billing address country == supplier legal entity country -> invoice to that legal entity (default).
- If Aurora requests to invoice a different legal entity: require a written PO exception from Redwood procurement (email thread + PO note) and include both: PO number, invoice_legal_entity_vat_id, and a short justification on the invoice.
- For resellers/sub-dealers issuing on behalf of Aurora: require full agent/broker declaration and proof of VAT registration for the invoicing entity.

2) Spain / fiscal representative:
- If Aurora Iberia SL is using a non-resident VAT number or is represented by a fiscal agent, Redwood requires the signed fiscal rep appointment form (attached: spain-fiscal-rep-form.pdf) AND the fiscal rep's approved KYC (name, VAT id). With that, Redwood will accept invoices from the fiscal rep where the fiscal rep's VAT ID is present.
- The attached Aurora tax residency cert is helpful but not sufficient alone to waive the fiscal rep form where Spanish law requires it.

3) Withholding / reverse-charge handling:
- For intra-EU B2B SaaS where the customer is entitled to reverse-charge, Redwood will not gross up. AP will validate presence of supplier VAT ID and our VAT number on the invoice. If fields are missing, invoice will be put on hold.
- For services sourced from non-EU entities into EU entities, we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis; expect extra steps when local withholding applies.

4) E-invoice / XML fields we will use for auto-PO matching (mandatory):
- <POReference> (string) -> matches Redwood PO number exactly.
- <SupplierVAT> (string) -> supplier VAT/Tax ID used to validate VAT rules.
- <LegalEntityID> (string) -> matches our billing_entity_id from mapping table.
- <InvoiceCurrency> (string) -> currency used for payment run.
- <InvoiceLine/TaxRate> (decimal) -> used for VAT validation.
- Optional helpful fields: <SupplierRegistrationCountry>, <FiscalRepresentativeVAT>

Operational notes:
- Procurement (Laura) will add a billing_entity_id picklist to new POs for multi-entity suppliers. Finance will reject invoices missing LegalEntityID where billing_entity_id is set.
- If Aurora prefers split invoices for single PO, we will accept but require the extra XML field and a short lead-time to adjust AP rules.

Action items:
- Connor: confirm the billing_entity_id values in Aurora's portal match the attached CSV.
- Aurora (Maria): complete and sign the Spain fiscal rep form if you intend to invoice via a fiscal representative.
- Laura: will add a PO note template and exception flow in the procurement system.

Ben Carter
Director, Tax Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: entity-mapping-table.csv, spain-fiscal-rep-form.pdf

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@aurora-sys.com>

Connor / Ben / Laura —

Thanks for the clear guidance — this is very helpful. Quick updates:
- We updated our supplier portal to surface a "billing_entity_id" at the PO acceptance step. I attached the signed tax residency cert earlier and just uploaded the Spain fiscal rep appointment (signed) to the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/aurora/esp-fiscal-rep-sign.
- Per Ben's XML field list, we can emit the following in our e-invoice export: <POReference>, <SupplierVAT>, <LegalEntityID>, <InvoiceCurrency>, <InvoiceLine/TaxRate>, and <FiscalRepresentativeVAT> when applicable. We'll send a sample XML by EOD tomorrow.
- One operational question: if Redwood issues a monthly consolidated PO for multiple subscriptions across EU entities, will procurement allow per-invoice legal entity overrides without a formal PO exception each time, or should we request a standing PO exception for the account?

Requested next step: Connor — can procurement confirm whether a one-time standing exception can be added to PO PR-99821 to allow Aurora to choose invoice_legal_entity_vat_id for that PR until the end of Q3? If not, we will submit per-invoice exceptions.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Maria
Aurora Systems
